ACUTE NECROTIZING ULCERATIVE GINGIVITIS
Introduction
A polymicrobial, endogenous infection
Aetiology
Fusiform and spirochaete bacteria
Epidemiology
- In developing countries, seen almost exclusively in children; Related to
poverty and malnutrition (predisposing factors)
- In industrialized countries, most common in young adults with neglected
mouths; Immunosuppressive factors, smoking and stress have been
associated
